findings.title: Citrix security bulletin CTX693420: NetScaler ADC and Gateway fix for CVE-2025-5777
findings.summary_md: Citrix disclosed CVE-2025-5777 and shipped fixed builds on June 17, 2025, for insufficient input validation leading to a memory overread in NetScaler ADC and Gateway when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server. Fixed builds include 14.1-43.56, 13.1-58.32, 13.1-FIPS/NDcPP 13.1-37.235 and 12.1-FIPS 12.1-55.328, and the advisory recommends terminating existing ICA and PCoIP sessions. Publication date corroborated by the NVD record (published Jun 17, 2025) and contemporaneous reporting; the Citrix page itself blocks automated access.

findings.title: watchTowr Labs: How Much More Must We Bleed? Citrix NetScaler Memory Disclosure (CitrixBleed 2, CVE-2025-5777)
findings.summary_md: watchTowr researchers published patch-diff analysis attributing the leak to use of an uninitialized variable (CWE-457) in the nsppe binary: sending POST /p/u/doAuthentication.do with a login parameter but no value returns uninitialized stack memory inside the InitialValue element of the authentication response. The post provides a benign detection request plus vulnerable and patched response examples, and notes that a significant portion of the NetScaler user base had still not patched while in-the-wild exploitation was ongoing.

findings.title: Horizon3.ai: CVE-2025-5777 CitrixBleed 2 Write-Up... Maybe?
findings.summary_md: Horizon3's Jimi Sebree demonstrated a working exploit leaking up to 127 bytes per request, recovering legitimate user session tokens, an nsroot token for the entire appliance, and plaintext credentials from login request bodies. The write-up gives defenders hunting guidance: ns.log entries containing non-printable characters, a single account with concurrent sessions from multiple client IP addresses, session review via show sessions, and diffing show ns runningConfig -withDefaults output against known-good backups to spot added backdoor accounts.

findings.title: CISA adds Citrix NetScaler CVE-2025-5777 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
findings.summary_md: CISA added 'Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability' (CVE-2025-5777) to the KEV catalog on July 10, 2025, citing evidence of active exploitation, with a federal remediation due date of July 11, 2025. Date added and due date confirmed via the NVD record's KEV table.

findings.title: The Register: Now everybody but Citrix agrees that CitrixBleed 2 is under exploit
findings.summary_md: Jessica Lyons reported CISA's KEV listing of CVE-2025-5777, noting Citrix had said on June 26, 2025 there was no evidence of exploitation and only updated its blog on July 11 to urge immediate patching while stating there are no available mitigations. The article cites Kevin Beaumont's reporting based on GreyNoise honeypot telemetry showing exploitation attempts dating back to June 23, 2025, and Akamai's observation of a drastic increase in scanner traffic after exploit details went public.
